abstract: We have established 17 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines from human testicular germ cell tumors by using three different methods of in vitro cultivation. Cultures of only three of these cell lines, and of clones derived from two of them, differentiate extensively when the cells are seeded at low density. A comparison is presented of the results obtained with the three methods used to establish and maintain these cell lines, and some properties of the three pluripotential EC lines are summarized.
abstract_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍から、3種類の体外培養法を用いて17株の胎児性癌(EC)細胞株を樹立した。これら細胞株のうち3株、およびそのうち2株由来のクローンのみが、低密度で播種した際に広範に分化した。細胞株の樹立と維持に用いた3つの方法の結果を比較し、3株の多能性EC細胞株の性質を要約した。
